purpose: Identify a repository-capable execution scaffold that can pair with the already-qualified local Ollama model endpoint for WP-04 without changing the model or adding routing.

candidates.reason: Windows installation and direct Ollama integration are documented; scaffold can inspect/edit a git repository without NDV selecting solution files.
LocalEnvironment describes bash command execution while using the host shell; on native Windows this introduces avoidable shell-compatibility uncertainty for the first smoke.

prohibitions: Do not compare scaffold quality on P1 tasks during qualification.
Do not expose D-F5-01 until a binding-v2 passes the WP-04 validator.
Do not change the local model during scaffold qualification.
Do not enable model fallback or dynamic routing.
